build_note: PyAsyncDNS 1.0.0 is published only as a pure-Python sdist without dependencies. The image fetches it by hash, checks the GPLv3+ classifier, the absence of Requires-Dist and the SHA-256 of codec.py, datatypes.py, __init__.py and LICENSE.txt, builds it offline with the pinned setuptools 80.9.0 wheel (no build isolation; setuptools is uninstalled afterwards), and checks that the installed PyAsyncDNS/ package is byte-identical to the sdist.
dependencies_note: atheris 3.1.0 is the in-process fuzz bridge only; PyAsyncDNS 1.0.0 has no runtime dependencies. setuptools 80.9.0 is used only to build the sdist and is removed from the venv.
parser_family: PyAsyncDNS (codec.py DNSCodec.decode, decode_name and per-type RDATA decoders over datatypes.py DNSHeader/DNSFlags and record dataclasses)
api: PyAsyncDNS.codec.DNSCodec().decode(local DNS message bytes) -> DNSMessage (header with DNSFlags, questions, answers, authorities, additionals with typed ARecord/AAAARecord/CNAMERecord/MXRecord)
coverage: Python line tracing of the installed PyAsyncDNS package during valid-control replay; Atheris import instrumentation for the byte-input bridge
scope: One RFC 1035 DNS message from local bytes via PyAsyncDNS.codec.DNSCodec.decode (documented in the package's codec reference): header flags including the 3-bit z field, questions, and CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers with compressed names; valid response and query controls only. RDATA values are the fields of the codec's typed record objects (A/AAAA address text from the codec, CNAME target, MX preference and exchange); the harness only lower-cases names and adds the trailing dot, and rejects the codec's raw-bytes fallback. Importing PyAsyncDNS also imports its asyncio client, server and exfiltration modules, but nothing is started: no server, event loop or socket is created, and the container has no network.
